status: sharp quantitative conjecture; float screens with exact extremal recomputation

definitions.gamma: minimum over nonempty proper C subset S of slack(P union C)-slack(C)
definitions.eta: maximum x(S)-phi(S) over core x with x_i >= phi_i for every i in S

candidate_inequality: eta >= gamma for exact games at the leximin core point
proved_subcase: For every exact game, every core point phi, and every proper two-player S, eta >= gamma.
interpretation: The coefficient-one inequality is sharp in exact games and false under balancedness alone. The general exact-game statement remains conjectural.
